User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the NotaKu application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

nik.description: User's NIK (Nomor Induk Pegawai - Employee ID Number).

paymentInfo.description: Nomor pembayaran pengguna (e-wallet atau rekening bank).

jabatan.description: Jabatan atau posisi karyawan, misal: 'Teknisi Fiber Optik'.

registrationStatus.description: The registration status of the user's account.

appAccess.description: Defines which application modules the user can access.

jobDescLapangan.description: User's job description in the field.

masaBerlakuSimA.description: Expiration date of the SIM A driver's license.

masaBerlakuSimC.description: Expiration date of the SIM C driver's license.

Nota.title: Nota
Nota.description: Represents a single nota (receipt/report) in the NotaKu application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Nota entity.

userId.description: Reference to User. The ID of the user who created the nota.

userEmail.description: Denormalized email of the user for display purposes.

serviceArea.description: The service area the nota belongs to.

namaBarang.description: Name of the item or service purchased.

nominal.description: The nominal value/amount of the report.

namaPic.description: Name of the Person in Charge.

fotoEvidenUrls.description: A list of URLs for the evidence photos.

dateCreated.description: Date and time the nota was created.

tanggalVerifikasi.description: Date the nota was verified by an admin.

rejectionReason.description: Reason why the nota was rejected by an admin.

ProjectID.title: Project ID
ProjectID.description: Represents a Project ID used in financial reports.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProjectID entity.

projectType.description: The type of project this ID belongs to (e.g., B2B IOAN, PROVISIONING).

pid.description: The actual Project ID string (e.g., TIF-215/2026).

NetworkAsset.title: Network Asset
NetworkAsset.description: Represents a single piece of network equipment in a service area.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Network Asset.

name.description: A unique name or identifier for the asset (e.g., OLT-KDS-01).

assetType.description: The main type of the asset.

subType.description: A subtype for assets like OLT (Mini OLT/OLT) or FTM (EA/OA).

serviceArea.description: The service area the asset belongs to.

dateAdded.description: The date the asset was added.

kapasitas.description: The capacity of an asset, typically for ODP (e.g., '8', '16').

spec.description: The specification or model of an asset, typically for ODC.

mitratelSiteId.description: Site ID from Mitratel for a Mitratel asset.

tenantSiteId.description: Tenant Site ID for a Mitratel asset.

qrCodeUrl.description: URL of the QR code for the asset.

MapLink.title: Map Link
MapLink.description: Stores a Google My Maps link for a specific Service Area.

serviceArea.description: The service area the map link belongs to.

url.description: The URL of the Google My Maps.

MancoreLink.title: Mancore Link
MancoreLink.description: Stores a labeled URL for a specific Service Area, typically linking to external resources like Google Drive.

serviceArea.description: The service area the link belongs to.

label.description: A descriptive label for the link (e.g., 'Peta ODP', 'Dokumen Jaringan').

url.description: The URL the link points to.

Pelanggan.title: Pelanggan
Pelanggan.description: Represents a customer with location and contact information.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created this customer record.

userEmail.description: The email of the user who created this customer record.

koordinat.description: GPS coordinates of the customer's location.

fotoCpUrl.description: URL of the customer's location photo.

serviceArea.description: The service area the customer belongs to.

dateAdded.description: The date the customer was added.

odpName.description: The name of the ODP asset connected to the customer (e.g., ODP-KDS-FA/001).

odpPort.description: The ODP port number the customer is connected to.

odpQRCodeUrl.description: The URL of the ODP's QR code.

RiwayatGangguan.title: Riwayat Gangguan
RiwayatGangguan.description: Represents a single service/outage history record for a customer.

pelangganId.description: The ID of the customer this history belongs to.

tanggalLapor.description: The date the report was made.

teknisi.description: The name of the technician who handled the report.

keterangan.description: A description of the issue and resolution.

NetworkStats.title: Network Statistics
NetworkStats.description: A summary document containing aggregated counts of all network assets.

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: Represents a work schedule for a user on a specific day. This can also be used to log leave (Ijin, Cuti).

notes.description: Reason for leave or other notes.

evidenceUrl.description: URL for leave evidence (e.g., doctor's note).

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: An attendance record for a user's scheduled shift.

reason.description: Reason for a non-standard check-in (e.g., late).

Holiday.title: Holiday
Holiday.description: A national holiday or collective leave day.

AlkerTool.title: Alker Tool
AlkerTool.description: Represents a single piece of work equipment (Alat Kerja).

toolName.description: The name of the tool, e.g., 'Splicer'.

photoUrl1.description: URL for the main photo of the tool.

photoUrl2.description: URL for the serial number photo, if applicable.

AlkerChecklist.title: Alker Checklist
AlkerChecklist.description: A checklist submission for a technician's work tools.

userId.description: The ID of the technician submitting the checklist.

crewUserId.description: The ID of the crew partner, if any.

tools.description: A list of tools checked by the technician.

Message.title: Chat Message
Message.description: Represents a single chat message in the application.

userId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

userName.description: Denormalized name of the user for display.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

ChatRoom.title: Chat Room
ChatRoom.description: Represents a private chat room between two or more users.

participants.description: Array of user IDs participating in the chat.

participantNames.description: Map of user IDs to display names.

participantAvatars.description: Map of user IDs to avatar URLs.

PrivateMessage.title: Private Chat Message
PrivateMessage.description: Represents a single message within a private chat room.

userId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

Performance.title: Performance
Performance.description: Represents a monthly performance record for a technician.

nik.description: Technician's NIK, used as a foreign key to the User entity.

userId.description: The user ID of the technician.

date.description: The date representing the performance period (e.g., first day of the month).

firestore.reasoning: The data is structured with a top-level `users` collection for profiles and a top-level `notas` collection for all user-generated notes. This flat structure for `notas` simplifies querying, allowing all users to view all notes easily, which aligns with the application's requirements. Security is enforced within the rules: while reads are permissive, writes (create, update, delete) are strictly controlled. A user can only create a nota with their own `userId`, and can only update or delete notas they own. Admins are granted special privileges to update any nota for verification purposes. A `network-assets` collection is added for managing network equipment, with admin-only write access. This design is efficient and secure for the specified use case.
